name: aobplatform
description: AoBPlatform monorepo root. Read CLAUDE.md and CONVENTIONS.md before adding anything here.
//jsdom: WHY jsdom IS A ROOT devDependency. Vitest is hoisted here, and it resolves 'jsdom' from its own location — this directory — not from apps/web, which is where the dependency is declared and where npm nests it. Until 4 September 2026 that mismatch was masked: the retired apps/kiosk pulled jest-environment-jsdom, which left a jsdom@20 hoisted here that vitest quietly used. The first npm install after the kiosk left pruned that copy and every web test stopped collecting with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Declaring it here is the honest version of what was true by accident. apps/web keeps its own declaration: it is the package that actually uses a DOM.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w packages/vault-client && npm run build -w packages/auth-client
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w apps/connector -w apps/core -w apps/rules -w apps/vault -w apps/web --if-present
